notes: Reached GB storefront via the Akamai interstitial proof-of-work solver (curl_cffi chrome-impersonation session). Checked: the full mega-menu tree embedded as JSON in the homepage's serverApp-state, robots.txt, and the site's own GB category sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-gb-0.xml.gz, 322 URLs). Found exactly one standalone New Arrivals-type page: the top-level nav item 'NEW IN' -> https://www.zarahome.com/gb/new-in-collection-n942, confirmed present as its own entry in the GB sitemap (seoId 942, own canonical URL, not a celement-anchored widget). A second internal menu entry, also labelled 'NEW IN' (key E-I-K_K_NOVEDADES_PLANA, seo keyword 'kids'), resolves only to /gb/kids-n1094?celement=1020461937 -- an in-page curated content widget embedded inside the general Kids landing page (same non-genuine pattern documented for this company's Bestsellers entries), not a separate sitemap-listed URL, so it was not emitted as its own row. Opened the genuine New In page (rendered <title> = 'New in | Zara Home United Kingdom'): confirmed it is a real, flat, catalogue-wide, filterable/sortable product grid (colour/price/size filters present), not an editorial or lookbook page. Read the exact server-rendered API response embedded in the page's own serverApp-state transfer-state for the call the page itself made to /itxrest/3/catalog/store/84009906/80290024/category/1020447643/product?showProducts=false&showNoStock=false&withSubCategories=false&languageId=-1: gridElements (the actual rendered grid) contains 377 unique commercial-component tiles (289 'Product'-kind + 88 'Bundle'-kind) under section 'All Products'. The same response's raw productIds array reports 378 (one id present in the raw list that is not actually rendered as a grid tile), and sortedProductIds reports 290 (confirmed by set arithmetic to be the Product-kind tiles only, deliberately excluding the 88 Bundle-kind tiles). Used 377, the count of tiles the page itself actually renders/displays, as qty -- consistent with the exact-grid-tile-count method the prior Home-Decor pass established for this storefront (Zara Home GB renders no plain 'N items' text header anywhere). Independently re-fetched the whole page a second time with a fresh interstitial solve: got identical figures both times (378 raw / 290 sorted-products-only / 377 rendered tiles), confirming stability. No genuine New Arrivals sub-structure exists as separate sitemap-listed URLs, so this is emitted as a single row.
